resources.string: Adds items you approved to a shopping app\'s cart

When you approve a cart, SmartCart opens the shopping app and adds exactly the items you approved, then checks the cart. It reads only that app\'s screens while the task runs, never touches payment, passwords or codes, and stops the moment you press Stop. In this test build it works only with SmartCart Test Store.

After you allow this, turn on “SmartCart cart helper” under Settings → Accessibility. In this development build it works only with SmartCart Test Store, and only when the Test Store switch is on in Developer settings; otherwise this step is simulated.
